question: Do population-derived joint uncertainty and soft growth identification add value to the existing 50/50 spatial blend, individually or together?
scope: 77 original TRAIN designs, 4454 physical clips, original five outer design folds and seeds42/43/44. No reserved selection/calibration/test scoring, new simulation, production change or GRU decision.
outer_split: Reuse physical_joint_inference_20261001 and frozen warning-study proper-fit/calibration/held-design rows exactly. All excitation and acquisition copies stay with their physical design.
crossfit: Three deterministic design folds inside each proper-fit partition (seed1047+outer fold), refit one107/full174 base MLPs and the physical prior/error model on two folds; predict the third. Combiner inputs and residual labels use only this first-level OOF table, never in-sample component predictions. Calibration and outer queries reuse frozen proper-fit base and physical models. Original MLP32->16 alpha1 and convergence limits retained.

readouts.joint: Full joint_soft posterior margin mean minus blend, lower/upper minus posterior mean, and instability probability (four columns).
readouts.soft: Full joint_soft posterior growth minus measured growth and growth standard deviation (two columns).
readouts.interpretation: These are two readouts from one shared physical/error model, not independent estimators. Ablate downstream use of uncertainty versus growth correction; do not claim fully separate underlying mechanisms. No simulator truth, margin, ucrit, hidden design parameters or mode identity at inference.

control_inputs: Blend point, one-minus-full point disagreement, measured growth, measured frequency, usable fraction, relative fit error and lead energy. All already available to the spatial predictors; controls distinguish extra fitting/quality information from the new physical readouts.
combination: Point = unchanged blend + train-OOF residual ridge correction. Fixed normalized L2 lambda0.1 (sum-square ridge alpha0.1*nrows), train-only existing ridge scaling, unpenalized intercept; no outer-outcome tuning. Affine control uses blend only; control uses seven existing columns; joint/soft/both add their designated columns. Frozen/adaptive arms leave the blend point bit-for-bit unchanged.
sham: Both new blocks jointly permuted by one deterministic source-clip permutation across all four views, separately within proper/calibration/held partitions; existing control inputs unchanged, no labels in permutation. Diagnostic only, not a deployable transductive method.
uncertainty: All adaptive arms use the same ridge log-absolute-residual scale head, trained on proper-OOF rows and their arm-specific point residuals (numerical log floor1e-8), same lambda0.1/scaling. Frozen arm preserves existing constant-width/calibration-RMS uncertainty. Calibration-only90% standardized absolute-residual quantile gives raw intervals; finite-sample90% design-max standardized residual order statistic gives group intervals. Gaussian residual probabilities use calibration normalized RMS times learned positive scale; approximate, not an exact Bayesian posterior. No claim that scale-head fitting alone is a new method.
warning: For every arm, calibrate separate stable false-warning thresholds at1/5/10/20% budgets on four views of calibration designs; no threshold transfer between models. Report observed false warnings/misses on outer designs; no operational guarantee under shift or early-warning trajectory claim.
evaluation: Retain all37 existing conditions; clean and eight fresh independent/correlated1%/5% draws949-952 are primary. New noise views are not additional physical designs. Per-design MAE, stable/unstable last1/2/5% and far-stable errors, dangerous overestimation, availability/false-safe, coverage/width/interval score, Brier/log score and warning tradeoffs.
comparison: Joint, soft and both must be compared with frozen blend AND matched_control, plus adaptive/affine/sham controls. Fixed-prediction2000 paired whole-design bootstrap retaining all initialization seeds; no refit/seed uncertainty or multiplicity guarantee. Do not equate an interval crossing zero with equivalence/noninferiority.
decision: No automatic adoption. A gain attributable only to generic recalibration or scale fitting is not credited to the paper mechanisms. Assess aggregate and boundary guardrails, useful calibrated availability and false-alarm tradeoffs together; preserve failed outcomes. No additional sweep selected from outer results.
timing: Warm cached174-feature row to final point/interval/probability, including both frozen base predictors, physical readouts and heads, median/p95; unchanged waveform extraction excluded.
